gearslots_autopickup_on: {0}: auto-pickup was off and its key is unbound, so it is switched back on
gearslots_standdown: {0}: the gear slots are off because {1} uses the same inventory cells.
gearslots_standdown_moved: {0} item(s) from your gear slots were moved into your bag.
gearslots_standdown_left: {0} didn't fit and are still in the old gear cells: make room in your bag and log in again.
gearslots_key_unbound: {0}: {1} is used for {2}, so the game's "{3}" key was unbound (bind it to another key in Settings, Controls)
gearslots_key_back: {0}: the game's "{1}" key is back on {2} (the mod no longer uses that key)
